## Real Agentforce projects (Gentrop, internal — no public demo link)

- IT support agent integrated with Google Chat for diagnosing issues and automating ticket creation/escalation, plus a multi-agent architecture for device lifecycle and WhatsApp logistics.
- Sales SDR agent qualifying leads with the BANT methodology, CNPJ validation via API, and automatic meeting scheduling.
- Consortium pre-sales agent over WhatsApp, with business rules and financial concept explanations to increase deal conversion.
- "Guigo" agent built for the Agentforce World Tour São Paulo: personalized triage, interactive quizzes and a profile-matching portfolio of agents, drawing 500+ booth visitors.
